name: Cauth Bodva

attributes.attribute: the Irish war-goddess Cauth Bodva anticipates
the goddess Cauth Bodva may be identical with

text: Cauth Bodva is a goddess honored in Gaul. She anticipates Badb, the Irish war-goddess. MacKillop presents her as a continental forerunner of that figure. Cauth Bodva may be the same figure as Cathubodua. The tie links Gaulish cult names to their Irish counterparts.

okr.objective: Place Cauth Bodva among the Gaulish forerunners of Irish battle goddesses.
key_results: MacKillop calls Cauth Bodva a Gaulish forerunner of Badb.
Badb serves as the Irish war-goddess.
Cauth Bodva may be the same figure as Cathubodua.
